service: bookingsystem-api

frameworkVersion: '4'

provider:
  name: aws
  runtime: nodejs20.x
  region: eu-north-1
  stage: ${opt:stage, 'dev'}
  deploymentBucket:
    name: bookingsystem-serverless-deploys
  environment:
    DYNAMODB_TABLE: ${self:service}-${self:provider.stage}
  iamRoleStatements:
    - Effect: Allow
      Action:
        - dynamodb:Query
        - dynamodb:Scan
        - dynamodb:GetItem
        - dynamodb:PutItem
        - dynamodb:UpdateItem
        - dynamodb:DeleteItem
      Resource: 'arn:aws:dynamodb:${self:provider.region}:*:table/${self:provider.environment.DYNAMODB_TABLE}'

functions:
  # Exempel: Hämta alla bokningar
  getBookings:
    handler: backend/handlers/bookings.getAll
    events:
      - http:
          path: /bookings
          method: get
          cors: true

  # Exempel: Skapa ny bokning
  createBooking:
    handler: backend/handlers/bookings.create
    events:
      - http:
          path: /bookings
          method: post
          cors: true

  # Exempel: Hämta en specifik bokning
  getBooking:
    handler: backend/handlers/bookings.getOne
    events:
      - http:
          path: /bookings/{id}
          method: get
          cors: true

  # Exempel: Uppdatera bokning
  updateBooking:
    handler: backend/handlers/bookings.update
    events:
      - http:
          path: /bookings/{id}
          method: put
          cors: true

  # Exempel: Ta bort bokning
  deleteBooking:
    handler: backend/handlers/bookings.deleteBooking
    events:
      - http:
          path: /bookings/{id}
          method: delete
          cors: true

resources:
  Resources:
    BookingsTable:
      Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
      Properties:
        TableName: ${self:provider.environment.DYNAMODB_TABLE}
        AttributeDefinitions:
          - AttributeName: id
            AttributeType: S
          - AttributeName: userId
            AttributeType: S
        KeySchema:
          - AttributeName: id
            KeyType: HASH
        GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
          - IndexName: UserIdIndex
            KeySchema:
              - AttributeName: userId
                KeyType: HASH
            Projection:
              ProjectionType: ALL
        BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
